query: SELECT MIN(s.started_at) AS started_at FROM twitch_stream_sessions s WHERE LOWER(s.streamer_login) = $1 AND s.id = ANY($2::bigint[]) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM twitch_session_chatters sc WHERE sc.session_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM twitch_chat_messages m WHERE m.session_id = s.id)
